observations: Red and black inverter welding machine.
Brand 'MAXMECH' and model 'MMA-300' are clearly visible on the machine's front panel and the retail box.
The machine features a digital display and a current adjustment dial.
Included accessories: electrode holder (red), earth clamp (silver), power cable, manual, and a basic hand-held welding mask.
The item appears to be in new or like-new condition with original packaging.

claims.evidence: photo 0 machine shows digital display and inverter-style housing

risks.risk: The machine may power on but fail to strike an arc or maintain stable welding current.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine successfully welding a metal joint.

risks.risk: Actual power output may be significantly lower than the 300A/7.8KVA label (common in budget inverter brands).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate on the back of the machine showing duty cycle and input/output specs.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard entry-level DIY welder

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and striking an arc.
Photo of the technical specification plate on the rear of the unit.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified. It can be priced as a used or open-box unit of this specific model, with the price adjusted to the worst-case scenario of it being non-functional until a video proof is provided.
